fact: The government's December 2020 account of its 2016-2021 action programme lists the SIGE among the education reforms and says the government put it into service in 2016 under the name Educmaster: a web application that follows each learner's path and school results from a unique identifier given to every learner (the numéro Educmaster), and whose use is made compulsory in all public and private nursery, primary, secondary and technical establishments; it names no funder and gives no count of schools.
title: État de mise en œuvre du Programme d'Action du Gouvernement : Éducation
publisher: Gouvernement du Bénin, Bureau d'Analyse et d'Investigation
